## Claudio Andres Gomez Villca is acting as an Emergency Delegate for this competition.

🟥 ¡Bienvenidos al Oruro Open 10th Anniversary 2026! 🟥
Este año celebramos con orgullo el décimo aniversario desde la primera competencia oficial en Oruro - Bolivia, que dieron inicio a nuestra comunidad.

🟥Welcome to the Oruro Open 10th Anniversary 2026! 🟥
This year we proudly celebrate the tenth anniversary since the first official competition in Oruro - Bolivia, which marked the beginning of our community.
